flags.why: The common sense referring to sarcastic or snide speech, as in nói mát mẻ, is missing ([dictionary](https://loigiaihay.com/tu-dien-tv/mat-me-eqb4mAEvnzVaj.html)).
flags.fix: Add: adj | sarcastic; snide (of speech); example: Anh ấy nói mát mẻ tôi. = He made snide remarks about me.

flags.why: Thá expresses contempt in these constructions, so colloquial alone does not warn learners that it can insult someone ([dictionary](https://tudientv.com/?t=th%C3%A1)).
